skill.name: research
skill.description: Investigate a question against high-trust primary sources and capture the findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when the user wants a topic researched, docs or API facts gathered, or reading legwork delegated to a background agent.
skill.summary: Research questions using primary sources and save cited findings as a Markdown note.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in this prompt-only skill. Manual review found no prompt-injection language, credential collection, data exfiltration intent, or other semantic security concern.

content.value_statement: Technical research often needs verified facts from authoritative sources. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to investigate and save cited Markdown notes.
actual_capabilities: Directs research toward official docs, source code, specifications, and first-party APIs.
Captures findings in a single Markdown file with source citations.
Supports background research while the main assistant continues other work.
Encourages each claim to be traced back to the owning source.
Saves notes in the repository location that best matches existing conventions.
limitations: It does not provide its own search engine or browsing tool.
It depends on the assistant having access to relevant sources.
It does not automatically verify facts after source pages change.
It may create a Markdown file in the repository when used as instructed.

use_cases.title: Verify API Behavior
use_cases.description: Research official API docs and source repositories before implementation decisions.

use_cases.title: Compare Framework Options
use_cases.description: Gather cited facts from primary sources for technical design discussions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Documentation Notes
use_cases.description: Create a repository research note that records sources and findings for future readers.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Fact Check
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one focused answer from official sources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research whether [tool or API] supports [feature]. Use primary sources only and save a short cited Markdown note.

prompt_templates.title: Implementation Research
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer needs enough detail to make a coding decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the official guidance for implementing [task] with [technology]. Include version constraints, cited claims, and unresolved questions.

prompt_templates.title: Source Comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: A team needs to compare several authoritative options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A], [option B], and [option C] using their official documentation or source code. Save a cited Markdown summary.

prompt_templates.title: Architecture Evidence File
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user needs a durable research artifact for review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate [architecture question] using primary sources. Create a repository Markdown note with findings, citations, tradeoffs, and recommended next checks.

output_examples.input: Research whether the current React docs recommend a specific data fetching library.
output_examples.output: A Markdown note summarizing the official React guidance, cited links, and any limits found in the docs.

output_examples.input: Find the official migration path for a package upgrade.
output: A cited summary of migration steps from the package maintainers.
A list of breaking changes relevant to the repository.
A note about source pages that did not answer the question.

output_examples.input: Compare two database client libraries using primary sources.
output_examples.output: A repository research file with cited capabilities, constraints, version notes, and a concise recommendation.

best_practices: State the exact research question and expected decision before using the skill.
Ask for official documentation, source code, specifications, or first-party APIs as sources.
Review the saved Markdown note before relying on it for implementation work.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for uncited summaries from blogs or forum posts.
Do not ask it to decide without preserving source evidence.
Do not treat the generated note as current after major dependency or API changes.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant to research a question using primary sources and save cited findings as Markdown.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it execute code?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill contains only prompt instructions and no executable code.

faq.question: Can it browse the web by itself?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the host assistant and available tools for source access.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: The skill asks the assistant to follow repository conventions, or choose a sensible Markdown location.

faq.question: What sources should it use?
faq.answer: It prefers official docs, source code, specifications, and first-party APIs over secondary articles.
